title: The Round Tea Party
description:
You find an [orange]invitation[/orange] for a [blue]"Sir Galalot"[/blue] to a tea party and decide to show up in his stead.

Upon entering an unassuming rotunda, you find yourself in the midst of [gold]commanders[/gold], [aqua]generals[/aqua], [red]warlords[/red], and [blue]mercenaries[/blue] having... tea?
The gigantic knight donning a [gold]golden crown[/gold] speaks.

[jitter]"Thou art late for [b]Tea[/b]?!"[/jitter]
conditions: All players must have at least 12 HP
notes: This event features two distinct outcomes: [green]Enjoy Tea[/green] provides immediate full healing and the Royal Poison relic; [red]Pick a Fight[/red] triggers a forced continuation where you take 11 HP of [b]unblockable, unpowered[/b] damage and obtain a random relic from the relic pool. The damage cannot be prevented by block or reduced by powers.
